system: male C57BL/6JRj mice, 12-week exposure, separate sacrifice groups, TAA groups n8 each
measurement: PSR collagen proportionate area percent, group medians and quartiles
primary: Transfer CCl4 day0/day7 healthy-offset exponential rate unchanged; initialize with TAA healthy and day0 medians; evaluate day7 and day14
secondary: Fit TAA day0/day7 for retrospective day14 description; day7 in-sample excluded from evidence of prediction
role: All values inspected before specification; retrospective same-study transfer check, not independent validation
metrics: signed and absolute CPA percentage-point error at7/14days
MAE over7/14days; TAA-fit MAE includes in-sample point and is descriptive only
criterion: Primary day14 absolute error smaller than constant baseline; descriptive criterion only, no clinical threshold or significance claim
sensitivity: 243 quartile corners for CCl4 healthy/day0/day7 and TAA healthy/day0; no probability or CI interpretation
